jobs.title: Sales Enablement Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

  

WorkWave is looking for a Sales Enablement Program Manager to help turn Sales Enablement priorities into organized, scalable, and well-executed programs for our growing sales organization.

Reporting to the Director of Sales Enablement, this role will serve as the program management and execution engine for the Sales Enablement function. The Program Manager will have significant responsibility for seller onboarding while also supporting ongoing training, Skill-Ups, Sales Plays, GTM and product launches, Sales Kickoff, manager enablement, and other strategic programs.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who loves making things happen. The right person can take an initiative from idea to execution, create structure around it, coordinate multiple stakeholders, facilitate when needed, keep timelines moving, and ensure programs don't end when the meeting does.

As WorkWave continues to build its Sales Enablement function, this person will help establish the processes and operating rhythms that allow the team to scale.

### **Primary Responsibilities**

### **Enablement Program Management & Execution**

* Manage priority Sales Enablement programs from planning through execution, reinforcement, measurement, and follow-up.
* Translate Enablement priorities into clear project plans, timelines, milestones, owners, communications, and deliverables.
* Maintain visibility across active Enablement programs, priorities, deadlines, and dependencies.
* Coordinate across Sales Leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing, Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and other subject matter experts.
* Proactively identify scheduling conflicts, dependencies, capacity constraints, and execution risks.
* Establish repeatable processes, templates, and operating rhythms that allow Enablement programs to scale.
* Ensure programs move from idea to execution with clear ownership and follow-through.

### **Seller Onboarding & Ramp**

* Serve as the primary program owner for seller onboarding execution.
* Coordinate onboarding schedules, communications, facilitators, SMEs, learning activities, and stakeholder participation.
* Create a consistent onboarding experience that can flex based on role, segment, product, region, and hiring volume.
* Partner with Sales Managers to establish clear expectations before, during, and following formal onboarding.
* Facilitate onboarding sessions where appropriate.
* Partner with the Senior Manager, Sales Enablement on Highspot learning paths, curriculum, content, and certifications.
* Track onboarding participation, completion, feedback, certifications, and agreed-upon ramp milestones.
* Identify opportunities to continuously improve the onboarding and ramp experience.
* Ensure onboarding remains organized and effective regardless of cohort size or hiring cadence.

### **Training, Skill-Ups & Reinforcement**

* Program-manage recurring Skill-Ups and other seller development initiatives.
* Coordinate SMEs, speakers, schedules, invitations, materials, recordings, attendance, communications, and follow-up.
* Facilitate selected training and Enablement sessions.
* Build reinforcement and follow-through into Enablement programs rather than treating training as a one-time event.
* Partner with Sales Managers to help translate learning into consistent seller behaviors.
* Coordinate manager enablement and reinforcement activities as needed.

### **GTM Launch & Sales Play Execution**

* Operationalize GTM and product launch enablement plans established by the Director of Sales Enablement.
* Coordinate audiences, timelines, training sessions, facilitators, communications, dependencies, materials, and follow-up.
* Partner with the Senior Manager, Sales Enablement to ensure required content, learning resources, and supporting materials are available within Highspot.
* Program-manage Sales Play activation, including seller communications, training, coordination, reinforcement, and follow-up.
* Maintain visibility into upcoming launches and Enablement requirements to support effective capacity planning.
* Ensure approved GTM initiatives are translated into organized, actionable seller experiences.

### **Enablement Operations & Communications**

* Maintain the Enablement calendar across onboarding, Skill-Ups, GTM launches, Sales Plays, strategic events, and other programs.
* Coordinate Weekly Wave production and stakeholder inputs in partnership with the broader Enablement team.
* Own operational details including scheduling, invitations, facilitator coordination, attendance, recordings, communications, action items, and follow-up.
* Represent Enablement in cross-functional meetings when appropriate and capture relevant decisions, dependencies, risks, and next steps.
* Help establish and maintain an effective intake and prioritization process for incoming Enablement requests.
* Provide additional coverage for early-morning and global Enablement programs as needed.
* Identify opportunities to streamline or automate recurring Enablement processes.

### **Sales Kickoff & Strategic Events**

* Serve as a key program management resource for Sales Kickoff and other major Sales Enablement events.
* Maintain project plans, timelines, owners, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Coordinate speakers, sessions, materials, communications, rehearsals, logistics, recordings, and follow-up.
* Partner with the Director of Sales Enablement on execution of the overall SKO strategy and seller experience.
* Help ensure strategic events translate into continued learning and reinforcement after the event.

### **Program Measurement & Continuous Improvement**

* Track participation, completion, feedback, and other agreed-upon program metrics.
* Partner with the Director of Sales Enablement and RevOps to improve visibility into onboarding, ramp, program adoption, and effectiveness.
* Conduct post-program retrospectives and identify opportunities to improve fut

jobs.title: HEA Project Manager
jobs.description:
World Vision is hiring a Project Manager to serve in the Humanitarian and Emergency Affairs Division.
  
  
AT A GLANCE
  
  
**Role:** Project Manager
  
**Status:** Limited-term; 12 months
  
**Reports to:** Director of Program Management
  
**Location:** Remote within the U. S.; Federal Way, WA or Washington, DC considered for hybrid
  
**Required Experience:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience (eight years). In addition to education or education equivalent, requires 3-5 years of work experience in project management or related field. Work experience must include at least one year of previous project leadership experience.
  
**Preferred Experience:** Direct experience managing large grants from US Government agencies, institutional foundations or individual donors preferred. Proven experience effectively managing large projects and successful resolution of implementation challenges.
  
**Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the U.S.A for any employer.
  
**Travel:** Up to 10% domestic and international travel, based on role needs.
  
**Estimated hiring range:** $74,200 to $102,760
  
  
THE JOB
  
​World Vision is looking for a Project Manager to manage projects on behalf of division, establishing priorities for complete project life-cycle including the planning, design, testing, and implementation of projects designed to meet requirements of business clients. Oversee the work of project teams. Lead team reporting and data systems management. May participate in the completion of corporate-wide projects, with responsibility for assigned components of the project. Support USG funded RISE consortium with reporting & data management.
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  

* Keep Christ central in individual and corporate life. Actively participate in and contribute to the spiritual disciplines of the organization (Christian conduct, chapel, prayer, worship, devotions, and leadership of devotions); incorporate WV Core Values into decisions within scope of role.
* ​Responsible for the outcome of projects with varying size and scope that may have designated budgets.
* ​ Oversee the entire project life cycle including the planning, design, testing, and project implementation.
* ​Lead coordination of consortium in donor reporting by working with project staff and partners to collect, analyze, consolidate, and edit high-quality donor reports and program updates.
* ​Define major tasks, deliverables, and milestones, based on scope, resources, budget, donor requirements, and personnel.
* Responsible for maintaining the master schedule and monitoring progress toward project milestones to ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* ​Manage resources required for the success of the project.
* ​Manage project related work efforts of contractors and internal WVUS staff members.
* ​Support the planning and coordination of consortium meetings, workshops, governance activities, and partner engagement efforts
* ​ May participate in the completion of corporate-wide projects, with responsibility of assigned components of overall project as required.
* ​ When applicable, manage project budget, modifying budget as needed and ensuring expenses do not exceed agreed upon budget.
* ​ Provide reporting on project progress to senior management and clients, ensuring any changes to budget, resources and risk are communicated in a timely way.
* ​Ensure accurate documentation of project results.
* Work collaboratively with team members when assigned to work as a member of a team.
* ​Manage semi-annual team reporting and information management systems, ensuring accurate, timely, and accessible program data for internal and donor reporting requirements..
* ​Support development and maintenance of dashboards, tracking tools, and reporting systems
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* Maintain awareness of corporate goals, objectives, organizational announcements, and activities. Reference and follow organizational policies and procedures, seeking clarity as needed.

YOU BRING THESE SKILLS
  

* ​​​​Project Management: Breaks projects down into time-phases and measurable milestones. Ensures activities produce results within constraints. Identifies people and resources needed. Considers costs and benefits of resources prior to allocating.​​
* ​​​Database Administration: Demonstrates familiarity with database administration techniques and concepts to ensure data and system design integrity.​ ​​​​Understands data relationships and demonstrates a commitment to maintaining data quality.​​
* ​​​​Business Acumen: Applies a broad-based understanding of key business fundamentals with knowledge of World Vision’s ministry, strategic relationships, and the organizational/political environment. Uses a high-level understanding of finance, operations, marketing, information systems, human resources, legal/regulatory issues and fundraising to manage projects across departmental and functional lines.​​
* ​​​​Facilitation Skills: Effectively and purposefully guides group meetings and manages group dynamics to foster team building and achieve meeting objectives.​​
* ​​​​Oral and Written Communication: Effectively expresses ideas, thoughts and concepts verbally and in writing, using correct grammar, organization and structure, and effective presentation media and techniques. Use appropriate media and approach.​​

REQUIREMENTS
  
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience (eight years). In addition to education or education equivalent, requires 3-5 years of work experience in project management or related field. Work experience must include at least one year of previous project leadership experience. Project management certification preferred.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Project Manager (Digital Marketing & Coaching Focus)  
Remote | Full-Time | Cross-Functional Teams  
  
We're looking for a highly organized and proactive Project Manager with a passion for digital marketing, personal development, and coaching. In this role, you won't just manage timelines—you'll lead client and internal projects from start to finish, ensuring everything runs smoothly, efficiently, and with purpose.  
  
If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy working with creative and strategic teams, and know how to keep digital campaigns on track while fostering positive relationships, this one's for you.  
  
As our Project Manager, you'll own multiple client and internal projects across the coaching and digital marketing space. You'll lead initiatives related to content creation, campaign launches, email marketing, funnel builds, virtual events, and more—coordinating across departments like design, copywriting, and tech.  
  
You'll be the central point of alignment, keeping deliverables on track, supporting client needs, and ensuring deadlines are met without sacrificing quality.  
  
Key Responsibilities  

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of digital marketing & coaching-related projects
* Serve as the primary liaison between internal teams, stakeholders, and clients
* Define project goals, timelines, and deliverables aligned with business and coaching outcomes
* Coordinate across content, design, automation, and client success teams
* Manage timelines using tools like ClickUp, Trello, or Asana
* Run daily/weekly stand-ups, team syncs, and progress check-ins
* Create and improve SOPs, workflows, and systems that enhance team efficiency
* Maintain organized documentation, task tracking, and communication logs

  
What We're Looking For  

* 2–5 years of project management experience, preferably in digital marketing or coaching industries
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and juggle multiple active projects
* Familiarity with marketing campaigns, launches, or coaching program operations
* Strong experience using project/task management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, etc.)
* Exceptional communication and leadership skills
* Highly detail-oriented, results-driven, and comfortable in remote work environments

  
Bonus: Experience with funnels, email platforms (e.g., HighLevel, ActiveCampaign), and coaching client onboarding  
  
What We Offer  

* 100% remote work with a collaborative, mission-driven team
* The opportunity to manage high-impact projects in coaching and personal development
* Flexible schedule with a culture of ownership and accountability
* Room for growth into strategic or leadership roles
* A team that values clarity, purpose, and transformation—in work and in life

* Knowledge of process improvement techniques and ability to direct improvement initiatives

jobs.title: Customer Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
The Customer Implementation Project Manager is responsible for managing new customer implementations assigned to them. They will act as the quarterback of the implementation process and work with leaders and individual contributors from various teams to ensure all action items are completed and all deadlines/deliverables are met. The Implementation Project Manager will be responsible for scheduling and leading all internal implementation meetings for implementations and driving clear communication throughout the implementation process. This position will work closely with external key stakeholders and the following internal teams: Sales, Account Management, Supply Chain, Installation, Field Services, Plant Operations, Clinical Education, and any other teams involved in the implementation process.

### **What you will do**

* Lead end-to-end customer implementations from project handoff through installation, go-live, and transition to ongoing support.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and project lead for customers throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Develop and maintain project plans, including scope, milestones, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and risks.
* Facilitate customer kickoffs, implementation meetings, readiness reviews, and post-launch follow-up activities.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams including Sales, Account Management, Operations, Supply Chain, Installation, Technology, Clinical Education, Training, and Client Success.
* Drive accountability for project deliverables, action items, and deadlines across internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor implementation progress, proactively identify risks, and develop mitigation plans to keep projects on track.
* Maintain project documentation, status reports, risk logs, action plans, and launch readiness materials.
* Manage scope changes and ensure implementation requirements are documented and communicated effectively.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, tools, workflows, and the overall customer experience.

### **What we are looking for**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience managing customer implementations, onboarding programs, client delivery initiatives, operations projects, or related project management activities.
* Experience in healthcare, healthcare services, health technology, clinical operations, medical waste, or another regulated industry.
* Proven success leading complex, cross-functional implementation or deployment projects.
* Strong project management skills, including planning, dependency tracking, risk management, issue resolution, change control, and status reporting.
* Experience using project management platforms, CRM systems such as Salesforce, and collaboration tools.
* Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and make sound decisions in a dynamic environment.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.

### **Why work for us**

* **Job Stability** – As an essential service to healthcare, Daniels Health is non-seasonal and recession-proof
* **Comprehensive Benefits** – Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance effective on **Day One**; Paid Short-Term Disability; Company-sponsored Life Insurance; Voluntary Long-Term Disability and Accident Insurance
* **401K Matching Plan** – 50% employer match on up to 6% contribution (up to 3% employer contribution) with a 5-year vesting schedule and **no waiting period** on the match
* **Permanent Position** – Full-time, 40 hours per week with long-term career potential
* **Mission-Driven Work** – Be part of a company that’s making healthcare safer and more sustainable through innovative waste management solutions
* **Growth & Development** – Opportunities to expand your skills in leadership, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration within a supportive and evolving organization

**Who are we?**

We are a healthcare service company providing safety systems and medical waste collection for hospitals, medical centers, surgical centers, nursing homes and an array of customers within the healthcare setting. Our focus is delivering quality and safety-focused medical waste management services that reduce needlestick injuries, positively impact infection control and reduce environmental burden. As a service to our customers we dispose and treat medical waste on site at our treatment facilities across the U.S.

jobs.title: Program Manager (Remote US)
jobs.description:
Description

**The Work**

ICF is seeking a Program Manager to lead integrated delivery for a modernization effort for the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation’s (FDIC). The program supports cloud data modernization, enterprise analytics and AI operations within FDIC’s governance and security environment.

You will provide the management structure that connects workstreams, technical teams, FDIC stakeholders, and delivery commitments. You will plan and sequence work, manage backlogs and sprint execution, monitor cost and schedule, control risks and changes, and ensure that work products are complete, traceable, secure, and ready for FDIC review and acceptance.

Job Location: Remote

**What You Will Do**

* Lead program planning and execution across concurrent data, cloud, analytics, AI, and operations workstreams; maintain an integrated project plan and coordinate dependencies, milestones, and priorities.
* Establish sprint plans with epics, backlog items, success criteria, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and sprint demonstrations; sequence work to support approved priorities and release objectives.
* Manage the product backlog, requirements, code, artifacts, bug fixes, requirements baselines, system features, and business rules through FDIC GitHub Enterprise or approved tools.
* Manage team and individual project budgets, track actual and projected costs, monitor burn rate, and provide cost projections and timely corrective actions.
* Prepare weekly status reports covering cost, current and planned activities, schedule, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action items; provide clear briefings to FDIC stakeholders.
* Coordinate architecture, infrastructure, data, security, privacy, operations, and business stakeholder reviews; ensure decisions address cost, security, operations, technical standards, and mission requirements.
* Manage requirements, risk, issue, change, and configuration processes, including FDIC Change Control Board and ServiceNow processes for production changes and configuration items.
* Ensure deliverables and sprint outcomes meet acceptance criteria; coordinate quality reviews, continuous testing and validation, stakeholder feedback, and resolution of rework before submission.
* Oversee security and compliance coordination, including A&A and ATO support, NIST 800-53 controls, POA&Ms, Azure policy findings, hardening guides, Security Impact Assessments, and annual security assessments.
* Lead transition and continuity activities, including knowledge transfer, resource coordination, documentation handoff, communication channels, risk mitigation, and readiness for uninterrupted operations.

**What You Will Bring With You:**

* Demonstrated experience managing complex technology programs or projects with multiple technical workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Experience applying Agile delivery practices, including sprint planning, backlog management, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, retrospectives, and work tracking through GitHub, Jira, or comparable tools.
* Experience managing budgets, burn rates, schedules, risks, issues, action items, status reporting, and cost or schedule corrective actions.
* Experience coordinating cloud, data, application, security, infrastructure, or analytics teams and translating technical issues and trade-offs for business and government stakeholders.
* Experience managing requirements, deliverables, change control, quality assurance, acceptance criteria, and version-controlled project documentation.
* Ability to satisfy FDIC personnel eligibility and background-investigation requirements
* U.S. Citizenship required due to federal contract requirements.
* Candidate must reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S.

**What we would like you to bring:**

* Experience supporting federal or regulated technology modernization programs, particularly cloud, data management, analytics, AI, or enterprise platform initiatives.
* Experience with Azure, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure AI services, or comparable cloud technologies.
* Experience supporting FDIC or similar governance bodies, including enterprise architecture, security, privacy, data governance, change control, A&A, ATO, or configuration management processes.
* Experience developing project, risk, requirements, security, architecture, data, testing, UAT, and transition documentation.
* Experience using GitHub Enterprise, ServiceNow, Jira, Power BI, Azure Monitor, or comparable delivery and reporting tools.
* Experience establishing KPIs, agile metrics, quality measures, stakeholder feedback loops, and QASP-style performance reporting.
* Experience leading transition-in or transition-out activities, incumbent knowledge transfer, operational readiness, or continuity planning.
* PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, ITIL, or comparable project or Agile certification.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Government
jobs.description:
For People is improving government digital services for the disadvantaged population. We work directly with government agencies to modernize software, systems, and platforms so that they better serve people.

**Your Impact**
---------------

Every month, hundreds of thousands of people go looking for facts about Medicare and Medicaid. They are researchers, reporters, policy staff, and health care providers. When the data is hard to find, a file is too large to post, or a column quietly changes its name between releases, their work slows down or goes wrong.

This project supports the website where the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) publishes that data for the public. It hosts a large catalog of datasets, lookup tools, and dashboards from across the agency, available for download, as interactive tools, and via a public API. As Program Manager, you will lead the team that builds and runs it. This is a hands-on role. You’ll facilitate partner meetings, support the team when they are blocked, and get into project details as needed to report clearly on the team’s progress. You’ll work elbow-to-elbow with the project’s technical and product leadership. You will learn about the work enough to identify and help mitigate delivery risks and hold the team accountable for what we promise to government partners.

This position is a full-time position **contingent** on For People being awarded a federal contract. If awarded, this position’s expected start date is February 2027.

**Our Culture**
---------------

For People is a team of humans. We place a significant amount of emphasis on positive work-life balance, setting healthy expectations, and making sure our loved ones are taken care of first. That means picking a child up from school during the day or going for a mid-day walk is okay!

This position is ***100% remote***. Our entire team is remote across the United States, from the West Coast to the East Coast. There will never be a return-to-office, as we have none! Occasional travel to CMS headquarters in Baltimore, MD (2-3 times per year) is required. These trips are infrequent and scheduled well in advance.

This full-time position's published base salary range is between **$100,000 and $160,000** annually. This band ranges across both the Program Manager and Senior Program Manager pay band, which will be determined based on relevant experience. All positions include generous benefits (e.g., For People pays 100% of Gold-tier employee health insurance premiums) and annual company profit sharing.

**Your Opportunities**
----------------------

On this project, you will be the delivery lead on a cross-functional team of about 15 people spanning engineering, design, user research, and support functions. The team may expand to up to 25 members in the future. As the Program Manager, you will:

* Build a collaborative and trusting team culture across all disciplines in the program
* Run agile practices including sprints, planning cycles, demos, and retrospectives, all of which include CMS stakeholders
* Coordinate with CMS offices that publish data on the public portal; share progress transparently and build positive working relationships with partner contracting teams
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks to project delivery
* Keep the program in line with contract, security, and accessibility requirements, including Section 508 and the site's Authority to Operate (ATO)
* Report status and outcomes to CMS and For People leadership, using live dashboards wherever possible and finding efficiency gains through automation
* Lead the handoff from the current contractor in your first few months so users see no disruption

**You Bring**
-------------

* A humble and caring attitude aligning with For People’s values: passion, fun, curiosity, sustainability, humility, and respect
* 8+ years of relevant experience in program or project management, including managing government contracts
* Degree in management, public administration, information technology, or a related field

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Cyera is seeking a Program Manager, Identity Security - Customer Success to design, own, and optimize scalable programs that help our customers adopt and get lasting value from Cyera’s identity security solutions. This role is a key interface between the Customer Success team, Product, and Sales Engineering, and will balance program management, content creation, and execution.

As identity becomes the control point for how people, machines, and AI agents access enterprise data, Customer Success teams need deep fluency in identity security and a repeatable way to bring customers to value. You’ll partner with Customer Success leadership, Product, Product Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to bring clarity, consistency, and creativity to onboarding, adoption, and readiness efforts. From CSE training tracks and customer onboarding programs to playbooks, presentation decks, and other materials, you’ll ensure that every asset is accurate, aligned to brand standards, and built for usability and visual polish.

This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong project ownership with a sharp design eye and a passion for helping customer-facing teams succeed through thoughtful, high-quality content and programming.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable Customer Success programs, including onboarding and adoption, across the identity security lifecycle.
* Own initiatives end to end, from concept and stakeholder alignment to content creation, delivery, and results tracking.
* Build readiness programs and learning paths that give CSMs working knowledge of identity security, including IAM, PAM, IGA, ITDR, and non-human and AI agent identities.
* Create clear, on-brand, visually engaging playbooks, presentations, and guides, and keep layout and branding consistent across formats.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Product Marketing, and Sales Engineering to align programs with priorities, messaging, and launches, and relay customer feedback and adoption blockers.
* Track and report on program metrics, such as onboarding time, adoption, and CSM readiness, and iterate on program design.
* Manage timelines, approvals, and dependencies, and support content QA and version control.

  
Requirements:  
  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 4+ years of experience in customer success, program management, enablement, or learning & development, preferably in cybersecurity or B2B SaaS.
* Proven track record designing and delivering programs that improve customer adoption or field performance.

Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of federal IT environments. jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Financial Data Analyst

**Location:** Peachtree Corners, GA (Fully Remote)

**Are you looking for a company that empowers talent?**

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this by empowering customers through the combination of the real and digital world.

From Day 1, you are empowered to create an impact with your full potential and creativity to make a difference for tomorrow.

We foster an inclusive and diverse culture where employees can be themselves while developing careers across multiple industries, technologies, and business functions.

**Create a better tomorrow with us!**

**Position Summary**

The **Financial Data Analyst** will own and coordinate the financial forecasting process for annual and periodic planning cycles. This role serves as the analytical bridge between Project Strategy & Planning, Operations, and Finance by transforming capacity plans, production schedules, customer demand, backlog, product mix, pricing, and historical performance into meaningful business forecasts and insights.

This position plays a critical role in providing visibility into factory performance, bookings, customer mix, product mix, and revenue outlooks across the our business. The analyst will help leadership understand where the business is performing today, where it is expected to perform tomorrow, and what operational factors are driving those results.

The ideal candidate is a highly analytical problem solver who enjoys working with large datasets, finding patterns, validating assumptions, and translating complex information into clear recommendations. This is primarily a data and analytics role with a strong focus on forecasting and business insights.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Forecasting & Business Planning**

* Own and coordinate business forecasting activities, developing monthly bookings, volume, and revenue forecasts using capacity plans, production schedules, backlog, customer demand, historical performance, and other business inputs.
* Support customer, product, factory, and business-level forecasting while partnering with stakeholders to ensure assumptions accurately reflect current business conditions.
* Analyze forecast changes, identify key business drivers, and communicate risks and opportunities impacting performance.

**Data Analysis & Business Insights**

* Create and maintain reporting that provides visibility into customer mix, product mix, factory loading, demand trends, and overall business performance.
* Analyze large datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers through scenario modeling and sensitivity analysis.
* Develop data-driven recommendations and translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insights for leadership and cross-functional teams.

**Data Validation & Forecast Reconciliation**

* Validate and reconcile data across schedules, operational reports, ERP systems, dashboards, and financial outputs to ensure forecast accuracy and consistency.
* Investigate data discrepancies, forecast variances, and reporting inconsistencies while maintaining documentation, assumptions, and controls that support transparency and data integrity.
* Establish and maintain trusted, repeatable forecasting processes and a reliable source of business performance data.

**Reporting & Process Improvement**

* Develop dashboards, management reports, trend analyses, and executive-level presentations that support business planning and decision-making.
* Standardize forecasting tools, templates, and reporting structures while improving data quality, reporting efficiency, and forecast visibility.
* Automate recurring reporting, validation, and data preparation activities and partner with digital and analytics teams to enhance forecasting capabilities and reduce manual effort.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, or 4 years equivalent experience in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
* 3+ years of experience in data analytics, forecasting, business intelligence, operations analytics, manufacturing analytics or financial analysis.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including complex formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, reconciliations, and large dataset analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work through ambiguity.
* Experience building dashboards, reports, and executive-level presentations.
* Ability to translate detailed data into actionable business recommendations.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel up to approximately 5% yearly.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Tableau, Power BI, SAP, KNIME, SQL, Smartsheet, Power Query, Power Automate, Python, or similar analytical tools.
* Experience in manufacturing, project-based, engineer-to-order, or configure-to-order environments.
* Knowledge of capacity planning, production scheduling, backlog management, customer demand analysis, and operational forecasting.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement experience.

**Benefits and Perks:**

Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html

The pay range for this position is $66,973 - $114,811. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. * Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and visualizations that communicate facility condition, asset performance, capital needs, costs, priorities, and program progress.

* Support the integration, import, export, and migration of project data between AECOM tools and client asset management, computerized maintenance management, and facilities management systems.
* Analyze client-provided datasets and determine how existing information can be incorporated into assessment and capital planning programs.
* Prepare data tables, summaries, graphics, dashboards, and other deliverables for technical reports and client presentations.

jobs.description:
**About Nebius:**

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

### **About Tavily (Acquired by Nebius)**

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.  
  
Tavily provides the search and intelligence layer that powers AI agents and retrieval systems with trustworthy, real-time information. We work with some of the most innovative teams in AI, from fast-growing startups to global enterprises, helping them build agents that are not only intelligent, but informed.

### **The role**

We're looking for a Business Analyst to partner closely with our Finance and Sales teams and turn data into decisions. You'll be the owner of the company's most important metrics: revenue (ARR/MRR), bookings, pipeline, conversion, net revenue retention, gross margin and more. Beyond reporting the numbers, you'll uncover the drivers behind them, build the analyses that shape planning and go-to-market strategy, and help leadership answer the critical questions:  
This is a high-ownership, hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in a board-deck conversation as in a SQL editor, and who ships analysis that changes what the business does next.

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Own the company's core business metrics end-to-end: define them, build the single source of truth, and make sure Finance, Sales, and leadership are all looking at the same numbers.
* Partner with Finance on revenue recognition, forecasting, budgeting, and board/investor reporting; turn usage and billing data into reliable financial views.
* Partner with Sales on pipeline health, funnel conversion, win/loss, sales cycle, quota attainment, territory and segment performance, and compensation analytics.
* Proactively monitor key business metrics, investigate trends and anomalies, and surface actionable insights to stakeholders before they ask.
* Build and maintain revenue and pipeline models that connect product usage and billing data.
* Write production-quality SQL and Python to model data, automate recurring reporting, and run analyses at scale.
* Translate findings into clear recommendations and drive alignment across Finance, Sales, and leadership.
* Support strategic initiatives: pricing and packaging changes, segment strategy, capacity planning, and go-to-market experiments, with before/after impact measurement.

**We expect you to have:**

* 5+ years of experience as an Analyst, of which 2+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, FP&A analyst, Revenue/Sales Operations analyst, or equivalent.
* 2+ years working in a SaaS company; you understand ARR, bookings, NRR, CAC, payback, pipeline coverage, and the metrics that drive a SaaS business.
* Hands-on experience supporting Finance and/or Sales teams, with a track record of owning metric definitions that the company relies on.
* Strong SQL and comfort working with large, messy datasets across different sources.
* Hands-on experience using Python for data analysis and data modeling in a production environment.
* BSc in Economics / Finance / Statistics / Math / Industrial Engineering or equivalent.
* Familiarity with modern data tooling (Snowflake/BigQuery, dbt, BI tools like Omni/Looker/Tableau).

**It will be an added bonus if you have:**

* Experience at an API-first, developer-focused, usage-based, or PLG (product-led growth) company.
* Experience with usage-based billing and revenue recognition (Stripe, Metronome, NetSuite).
* Experience with CRM analytics (HubSpot, Salesforce) and sales compensation / quota design.
* Statistical foundation for experimentation and causal inference.
* Experience with Airflow or similar orchestration tools.
* MBA or MSc in a quantitative field.

**Key employee benefits in the US:**

* **Health insurance:** 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
* **401(k) plan:** Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
* **Parental leave:** 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
* **Remote work reimbursement:** Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
* **Disability & life insurance**: Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.

**Benefits & Perks:**

* Competitive compensation
* Career growth and learning opportunities
* Flexibility and ownership
* Collaborative and innovative culture
* Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
* International environment and talented teams

**What's it like to work at Nebius:**

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.title: Project Manager, Content and Integrity Operations
jobs.description:
Integrity Operations strives to create a safe atmosphere for Meta's communities by way of effective support, education, and care for the various people around the world who use our platforms. We pride ourselves in helping prevent online and real-world harm by building fast, scalable support systems to address safety-related incidents on our products, and by influencing others to collaborate on cross-functional initiatives.Content and Integrity Operations' focus is on improving the health of our products and helping people understand how to use them through both direct support interactions as well as scalable solutions. Those who join our teams are committed to solving people's issues, and are advocates for the Facebook and Instagram communities. We need partners who can align cross-functional teams to improve the experience on our platforms.We are seeking an experienced project manager with a passion for mitigating real world harm and protecting our community to join our Content and Integrity Operations Team. We count on our project managers to deliver both qualitative and quantitative insight into user behavior in order to drive prevention and detection solutions at scale. By working cross-functionally, we identify and pursue areas for process and product improvement, enabling us to better protect our community at scale. And by focusing on decision quality, we ensure that we are held accountable for our actions. This role will work closely with partners across Security, Engineering, Policy, and other Meta teams to drive operational projects in a fast-paced and data-driven environment.

* Manage and improve day-to-day operations against quality and efficiency targets in a highly dynamic environment with shifting priorities
* Analyze data to identify user trends and malicious behavior and suggest recommendations to improve operations
* Use problem-solving skills to resolve large and complex business problems
* Lead investigations and resolve issues that are escalated to the team regarding potentially abusive content or real-world threats
* Help create scalable policies and processes to solve complex business problems and ensure the safety of the community
* Build cross-functional partnerships to create better solutions for our community and users
* Address sensitive content issues, including but not limited to graphic images, videos and writings, offensive or derogatory language, and other objectionable material
* This role may involve exposure to potentially graphic and/or objectionable content including but not limited to graphic images, videos, audio and writings, offensive or derogatory language, and other potential objectionable material, i.e. child exploitation, graphic violence, self-injury, animal abuse, and other content which may be considered offensive or disturbing
* Develop an understanding of content integrity issues and how they affect our community
* Track project milestones, deliverables, and timelines across multiple concurrent integrity initiatives, escalating blockers to appropriate stakeholders
* Compile and analyze operational data to surface trends, identify process gaps, and support reporting for integrity leadership
* Collaborate with policy, legal, trust and safety, and vendor operations teams to align on workflow requirements and process changes

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of experience in an operations, technology, management consulting, or equivalent environment

* Experience managing and prioritizing projects end-to-end across various stakeholders and functions
* Experience making data-informed decisions on content or operational issues, including documenting rationale and trade-offs and maintaining clear communication and sound judgment when managing competing priorities
* Capacity to work with potentially graphic and objectionable content

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience identifying process improvement opportunities and proposing data-informed solutions
* Exposure to process documentation methodologies and continuous improvement frameworks in an operations context
* Familiarity with Meta products and their community features
* Experience working in a content integrity, trust and safety, or online exploitation mitigation environment, including familiarity with child safety or non-consensual content policy areas
* Familiarity with content review operations workflows, escalation frameworks, or vendor management in a scaled operations setting
* 1+ year of experience working with data tools such as SQL, SAS, and data visualization (e.g. Tableau) tools
* Knowledge of other programming languages, e.g. Python, R

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. Meta is proud

* 2 years of experience managing cross-functional initiatives across Product, Marketing, or Sales/Go-To-Market stakeholders.

* Experience utilizing AI productivity tools to solve complex, multi-layered problems and streamline business or development workflows.
* Understanding of B2B product marketing work, commercial go-to-market (GTM) motions, and sales enablement workflows within a technology or digital advertising organization.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, structuring new processes, and running the operational cadence for senior leadership.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Application deadline: Oct 19, 2026  
  
A typical day centers on keeping the Food Safety Audits programs running smoothly and the 3P auditor relationship healthy and productive. The Program Manager II leads the Worldwide Grocery Stores retail food safety audit program, partnering with a third party audit vendor, food safety analysts, store leadership, and cross functional stakeholders to ensure compliance with FDA Food Code.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The role requires a results-oriented, analytical, customer-service approach to manage the audit program, measure progress, and drive risk management and compliance outcomes.  

* Manage the day-to-day execution of the Food Safety Audits programs, including the 3P Food Safety audit cycle — scheduling, coverage, standards alignment, and data integrity; works on one or more projects and may own a program.
* Own accountability to the 3P Food Safety Auditor’s KPI scorecard; monitor audit completion, on-time delivery, scoring consistency, and finding-closure metrics, and act to keep them on target.
* Manage the relationship with the 3P audit provider — align on audit standards and expectations, resolve data and scoring discrepancies, and hold the provider to KPI commitments.
* Analyze and trend large audit data sets from internal and external audits to identify emerging Food Safety risks, recurring violations, and improvement opportunities.
* Verify Food Safety policy and the FDA Food Code are correctly reflected in audit standards, checklists, and scoring criteria.
* Support Food Safety escalations arising from audits; track corrective and preventive actions to closure with Operations stakeholders.
* Optimize audit procedures, processes, and best practices to improve efficiency, data quality, and reporting cycle time.
* Anticipate near-term bottlenecks in the audit program; identify, track, and mitigate immediate issues and risks, escalating when appropriate.
* Write and publish audit performance and trend content for WWGS Business Reviews; convey findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with AMZ & WFM stakeholders to align audit processes with Food Safety policy and Operations needs.
* Stay informed of FDA Food Code updates, regulatory publications, and industry audit benchmarks, and apply them to the audit program.
* Begin to mentor peers and new team members on audit standards, data analysis, and the FDA Food Code.
* Make trade-offs across time, quality, and resources to deliver reliable audit outcomes; decide when to resolve independently versus escalate.

  
A day in the life  
Day-to-day responsibilities include:  

* Data governance of internal and third-party audits for stores across the US, Canada, and UK
* Data analysis to identify process gaps and resolution
* Maintaining relevant metrics for a food safety scorecard that measures each store's food safety performance
* Reviewing and resolving clarifications
* Monitor vendor performance through a KPI scorecard
* Ownership of food safety self-audit questions and data
* Creation and publishing of monthly and ad-hoc content for food safety culture (Food Safety Empowerment Teams)

  
About the team  
The Retail Food Safety team supports stores and company facilities with Food Safety policy, mechanisms to efficiently embed Food Safety in store processes, and a means to measure compliance. We bridge Food Safety to cross-functional stakeholders including Operations, Merchandising, Facilities, Procurement, and Leadership.

------------------------

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* 5+ years of managing food safety and quality in a large-scale retail or manufacturing environment experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Travel up to 25% of the time
* CP-FS (Certified Professional – Food Safety) certification, or a comparable Food Safety professional certification.
* Expertise in the FDA Food Code and retail food delivery/audit programs.

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

---------------

Ready to take on challenges at the leading edge of geopolitics and technology, and shape the future of cloud security? Our team does this every day. We are looking for a security professional with classic intelligence analysis experience, and expertise in geopolitical and security risk management to join us.  
  
Experience and knowledge in Information Security, cloud infrastructure, and/or the digital-physical security nexus is a plus for this role, but not strictly required. However, demonstrated capability for self-guided learning with practical or on-the-job application is critical to success.  
  
This role combines the functions of a traditional all-source intelligence analyst with risk manager and operational security advisor. Using these core skills, you’ll work through complex geopolitical factors and technical issues across multiple functional domains to deliver bar-raising security outcomes.
  
  
Our team leads internal efforts to understand, manage, and reduce risk to our cloud and supporting infrastructure from the earliest stages of development through global deployment. You’ll work independently and with stakeholders and customers in high-ambiguity/high-judgment situations to solve problems on a global scale. You’ll manage a portfolio of short- and long-term projects, bringing structure and identifying opportunities to provide decision advantage through deep analytic insights.  
  
Ideal candidates will have demonstrated consistently the ability to conduct rigorous research and analysis on a variety of geopolitical and security issues; produce foundational and boutique written risk intelligence products; provide security advice through option development and well-supported recommendations; and communicate effectively – in writing and verbally – on complex topics to mixed audiences (junior support personnel, deep technical SMEs, and senior executives).  
  
This role is non-technical, but in order to be effective you’ll need to pursue, acquire, and grow foundational cloud and related AWS technical and business knowledge. Though this is an in individual contributor role, you’ll need to use program management and people leader skills to collaborate and drive alignment across multiple cross-functional teams.

* Apply intelligence and risk industry standards and techniques (analytic tradecraft, various structured analytic techniques, ISO 31000, IEC 31010, etc.) to draw actionable analytic conclusions and develop effective risk mitigation plans

  

* Develop an in-depth understanding of potential impacts from geopolitical and security scenarios to AWS infrastructure and operations specifically, and hyperscale cloud and technology sector more broadly

  

* Plan, manage the production cycle, and deliver short- and long-form risk intelligence products, position papers, and other narrative documents

  

* Manage a portfolio that includes security risk and intelligence responsibilities for AWS global infrastructure investments, enterprise efforts, and specialty projects; develop and maintain collaborative relationships with customers, stakeholders, and partners; identify and pursue opportunities to raise the security bar within your portfolio and the team’s remit

  

* Communicate intelligence analysis, risk assessments, and security guidance to diverse audiences effectively through written narratives, group discussions, and one-to-one conversations.

  

* Be able to travel domestically and internationally, as needed

Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  
  
Training & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of business intelligence and analytics experience
* Bachelor's degree in business, international relations, or a security-related field
* 3+ years of managing a portfolio or program of analysis including direct involvement in the writing, editing, coordination, and publishing of multiple finished intelligence products or geopolitical risk reports within a given issue, functional, or geographic focus area \*Note: Experience and training can be from government,

Our company culture is focused on collaboration, empathy, curiosity, and trust, and our clients are changing the world in Washington, DC, and across the country through political discourse, social action, culture shift, and so much more.

At K2D, we respect and celebrate our differences and know that employees with varied life experiences, backgrounds and skills make us a stronger company and a great place to work. We aren’t shy about saying our team is the best in the business, and we wonder if you might be the perfect new teammate!

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Schedule and attend meetings; assist with creation of meeting materials and prepare and share notes with the internal team
* Coordinate strategy and campaign execution for digital and direct mail campaigns, including:
* + Develop and manage realistic, achievable project timelines, milestones, budget reports, technical requirements, and documentation for projects
  + Prepare cost estimates and ensuring projects are delivered on budget
  + Translate strategy briefs into creative instructions for writers and graphic designers and production specifications for implementation
  + Traffic copy, data and art, including coordinating kick-off meetings and vendor schedules, as well as gathering all necessary approvals
* Coordinate production of digital campaigns
* + Track production schedules
  + Provide QA for all digital campaign components
* Work within email platforms and follow email campaigns through set up, testing, reviewing user experience, deployment, and results monitoring
* Work within clients’ eCRM accounts to support email list management and fundraising campaigns
* Coordinate production of direct mail campaigns
* + Track production schedules
  + Provide QA for all campaign components (print proofs, counts, personalization set ups, and mailshop QC)
* Keep team up to date on campaign progress
* Effectively manage day-to-day communication with clients, team members, partner agencies, outside consultants and vendors to provide superior customer service, including integrating with media and account management teams as appropriate for a wide variety of projects
* Review and approve vendor invoices, reconcile final costs as needed

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Participate in webinars and attend conferences/workshops to expand skills.
* Share relevant findings with K2D staff at team meetings, staff meetings, etc.
* Other duties as assigned.

  
**Requirements**

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Team members who are most successful in this role typically have 2 or more years of project management experience, including professional roles, internships, academic projects, or other relevant experiences where you managed timelines and deliverables.
* Computer skills including fluency in MS Office Suite (especially Outlook and Excel)
* Proven organizational skills, project management, problem solving skills, and attention to detail
* Ability to handle multiple projects across multiple clients
* Excellent customer/client service skills and the ability to work in a team environment
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and attention to detail
* Self-starter with experience excelling within a fast-paced environment
* Technically curious and unafraid to ask questions and try new things
* Background in nonprofits or caused-based marketing highly preferred
* Preference will be given to candidates who can work a hybrid schedule in our Arlington, VA office

  
**Benefits**

**What We Offer**

* **Health and Wellness**: employer-subsidized health, dental, and vision insurance in addition to employer paid short-term disability and life insurance.
* **Work-Life Balance**: Flexible work hours, remote work environment (with access to our Arlington, VA offices for local employees), and generous time off
* **Financial Wellness**: competitive salary, 401(k) with company match
* **Professional Development**: ongoing training, career path development, and a dedicated budget for conferences and training seminars
* **Additional Benefits**: an opportunity to work with smart people in a supportive environment that celebrates individuality
* **Compensation**: our budget for this position starts at $45,000/year

We will be accepting applications for this position through November 6, 2026.

jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* 401(k) matching

**Description**

At DANE, we support some of the nation’s most complex programs with a team that blends technical excellence and true collaboration. We offer competitive benefits, generous PTO, and a culture where your work is recognized, impactful, and valued.

We are seeking an experienced **Information Security Analyst** to join our IT Security team and help protect the systems that support our mission. This role monitors, evaluates, and maintains the safeguards for information systems, networks, databases, and web-based assets across **on-premises and AWS cloud** environments, and produces reporting on risk, vulnerability management, and security incidents.

**Responsibilities**

* Monitor and analyze **Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS)** to identify security issues for remediation
* Recognize potential, successful, and unsuccessful intrusion attempts and compromises through thorough review and analysis of event detail and summary information
* Evaluate firewall change requests and assess organizational risk
* Communicate alerts to agencies regarding intrusions and compromises to their network infrastructure, applications, and operating systems
* Assist with implementation of countermeasures or mitigating controls
* Develop, test, and operate firewalls, intrusion detection systems, enterprise antivirus systems, and software deployment tools
* Maintain **PCI-DSS** certification for the IT system on an annual basis
* Safeguard the network against unauthorized infiltration, modification, destruction, or disclosure
* Research, evaluate, test, and implement new security software or devices
* Conduct investigations of information systems security violations and incidents, reporting to management as necessary
* Implement, enforce, communicate, and develop security policies and plans for data, software applications, hardware, telecommunications, and information systems security education/awareness programs
* Perform periodic and on-demand system audits and vulnerability assessments, including user accounts, application access, file system, and external web integrity scans to determine compliance
* Advise management on the business impact of theft, destruction, alteration, or denial of access to information
* Provide information assurance project management, technical security staff oversight, and development of mission-critical technical documents
* Ensure compliance with regulations and privacy laws
* Develop materials for computer security education/awareness programs
* Respond to queries and requests for computer security information and reports
* May serve as a team or task lead

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) or equivalent
* **Minimum 10 years of IT Security experience**
* Strong working knowledge of NIST Special Publications, including **NIST SP 800-37 and 800-53**
* Experience implementing and configuring **IDS, vulnerability scanning, SIEM**, and other security tools
* Knowledge of best practices for designing and implementing secure network architecture
* **2+ years of AWS experience (required)**
* Experience with security incident handling (preferred)
* Clear written and oral communication skills
* Ability to troubleshoot and solve complex technical problems

**Required Certifications**

* Current certification in one or more of the following:
* ISACA – Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
* ISACA – Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* (ISC)² – Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* (ISC)² – Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
* AWS Solutions Architect

*DANE LLC is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.*

jobs.title: Operations Research Analyst
jobs.description:
**MANTECH** seeks a motivated, mission-focused, and analytically rigorous **OPERATIONS RESEARCH ANALYST** to support Marine Corps mission engineering, warfighting analysis, and capability development efforts in **QUANTICO, VA**.

This is an on-site position supporting government and USMC customers in the evaluation of concepts, capabilities, technologies, and operational approaches through data-driven modeling, simulation, and analysis.

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis of Marine Corps warfighting concepts, mission threads, weapon system capabilities, and concepts of operation in support of mission engineering and operational assessments.
* Support mission engineering activities by helping define analytic problems, formulate research questions, and develop study plans that model Marine Corps capabilities in warfighting scenarios to assess system effectiveness and performance.
* Develop and apply analytical methods, run matrices, and evaluation frameworks to assess mission effectiveness, interoperability, capability gaps, integration issues, and trade-space options across Marine Corps, Naval, and joint systems and concepts.
* Interpret analytic results to identify trends, risks, capability gaps, and mission impacts, then translate findings into actionable recommendations that inform experimentation, capability development, and requirements development.
* Prepare and deliver technical research reports, briefings, visualizations, and other analytic products for government stakeholders, warfighters, engineers, and senior leaders.
* Collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and as needed, serve as a program or project lead for small analytic teams supporting mission-focused studies and related efforts.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations research, mathematics, statistics, data science, engineering, physics, computer science, or a related analytical discipline and at least 4 years of experience conducting quantitative analysis, developing analytical models, or supporting modeling, simulation, and analysis efforts. A total of 10 years experience without a degree.
* Experience applying structured analytical methods to complex problems involving multiple variables, objectives, constraints, and uncertainties.
* Proficiency with analytical and technical tools such as Python, R, MATLAB, SQL, SAS, SPSS, AFSIM, and data visualization platforms.
* Experience writing technical research reports, , analytic briefings, and visualizations for stakeholders and decision-makers.
* Ability to work effectively with analysts, engineers, weapon system operators, and subject matter experts in a collaborative environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced degree in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or related analytical discipline.
* Experience supporting Marine Corps, Navy, or joint warfighting analysis, mission engineering, concept development, experimentation, capability assessments, or requirements development.
* Familiarity with mission engineering methodology, including mission architectures, mission threads, measures and metrics, and scenario-based analysis.
* Experience conducting trade-off studies, sensitivity analysis, optimization, interoperability assessments, operational effectiveness analysis, or mission-level capability evaluations.
* Familiarity with simulation modeling environments, data management practices, and traceable analytic products that support decision-making.

**Clearance Requirements:**

* Must have a current/active TS/SCI security clearance.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Office work environment with occasional travel to outdoor test and evaluation sites. Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
* Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, meeting spaces, and collaborative work areas.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Pansophic Learning is an education company committed to providing students and educators with exceptional learning solutions that enable them to maximize their success academically and in life, regardless of geographic, financial, or demographic circumstances. Our solutions combine high-quality educational content, technology, teaching, and exceptional schools.

### **About the Role**

The Business Analyst is a key member of the Product & Technology department, responsible for analyzing complex business needs, identifying opportunities for improvement, and defining practical, scalable solutions that enhance our products, services, and operational processes.

This role requires **strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, a solution-oriented mindset, and the ability to collaborate closely with technical and functional experts**. The Business Analyst investigates business challenges, identifies root causes, evaluates solution options, and translates business needs into clear, actionable requirements that guide product development and implementation.

The ideal candidate is naturally inquisitive, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and skilled at connecting business needs with technical capabilities. Experience with educational technology, digital content publishing, and learning management systems is particularly valuable.

### **What You'll Do**

**Business Analysis & Critical Thinking**

* Analyze complex business problems, existing workflows, and system functionality to identify root causes, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Lead discovery discussions with stakeholders and subject matter experts to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and distinguish underlying problems from proposed solutions.
* Evaluate business processes, system capabilities, data flows, and operational dependencies to develop a comprehensive understanding of requirements.
* Apply structured analysis and critical thinking to assess potential solutions, trade-offs, risks, and downstream impacts.
* Recommend practical, scalable solutions that balance business value, technical feasibility, and operational effectiveness.

**Solution Development & Collaboration**

* Partner with technical and functional experts to explore solution alternatives and define approaches that address business challenges.
* Collaborate with software development, UX, QA, curriculum, and operations teams to ensure proposed solutions are feasible and aligned with business objectives.
* Translate complex business needs into functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting specifications.
* Identify dependencies, edge cases, integration considerations, and potential implementation challenges.
* Facilitate solution discussions, resolve requirements questions, and support informed decision-making throughout the development lifecycle.
* Collaborate on evaluating and prioritizing product enhancements, process improvements, and defects based on business impact.

**Product Delivery & Validation**

* Work closely with development teams to clarify requirements and provide functional guidance throughout implementation.
* Support the refinement of development work to ensure requirements are sufficiently defined and understood.
* Develop test scenarios and participate in functional validation and user acceptance testing.
* Evaluate delivered solutions against documented requirements and intended business outcomes.
* Identify gaps, recommend adjustments, and coordinate with stakeholders to resolve outstanding issues.
* Support implementation, training, and rollout activities to ensure successful adoption.

**Educational Technology & Content Publishing**

* Analyze workflows related to digital curriculum, content publishing, course configuration, and distribution across educational platforms.
* Collaborate with curriculum, academic, and technology experts to understand publishing processes, system dependencies, and content lifecycle requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of course management and content distribution.
* Evaluate workflows and integrations across Learning Management Systems (LMS), Student Information Systems (SIS), and other instructional technologies.
* Support solution development involving course access, content availability, platform configuration, and system integrations.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Communication**

* Build collaborative relationships with business leaders, customers, functional experts, and technical teams.
* Facilitate discussions that bring together different perspectives to analyze problems and develop shared solutions.
* Communicate complex technical concepts in business terms and translate functional needs into actionable guidance for technical teams.
* Present findings, recommendations, solution trade-offs, and business impacts clearly to stakeholders.
* Maintain visibility into requirements, decisions, dependencies, and delivery progress.
* Promote alignment between business objectives, user needs, and technical capabilities.

### **Key Deliverables**

The Business Analyst is expected to produce high-quality, actionable analysis and documentation that supports informed decision-making and successful solution delivery.

* **Business Needs & Gap Analysis:** Current-state assessments documenting business challenges, root causes, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* **Solution Analysis & Recommendations:** Evaluations of potential approaches, technical feasibility, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs, with clear recommendations.
* **Business & Functional Requirements:** Well-defined requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, and functional specifications.
